nom: The Ordinary Aloe 2% + NAG 2% Solution for Post-Acne Marks

avis.texte: I didn't buy this serum for the longest time because I thought it was meant for acne marks. I am so glad I decided to buy it! I had a scar on the top of cheek bone right below my eye from splitting my face open due to a fall. This scar was 6 years old and it was it was about an inch long and pretty deep. Nothing i tried improved it at all. I am currently on my second bottle of this serum only using it once a day and I can hardly see my scar at all anymore!!! It's practically gone! This serum has completely changed the texture of my skin and I truly am amazed! If there was ever a product that desrved to be hyped up, this is one is it!! It's not sticky it absorbs very well and it doesn't have any scent to it at all. I would absolutely recommend this serum for anyone wanting to improve their skins texture.

DO NOT use if you have sensitive skin. Completely burned off the skin on part of my nose, and gave me more acne than I had before. My skin felt like it was burning the next day. Did not clear my marks at all. Stopped use after trying it once.

Was rooting for this, but unfortunately it did nothing for my dark spots nor did it really "soothe" my skin during an acne flare. Finished the whole bottle since i paid for it, but won't be repurchasing. Very runny consistency, 2 stars for absorbing nicely, but that's about it

avis.titre: i always buy this changed my life
avis.texte: i've started buying the aloe 2% and nag 2% solution about last year when i had crazy acne and dark spots around my face when i tell you this cleared it up so quick!! i pair it with the azelaic acid and a light weight moisturizer and trust me you'll see the difference!!
It's affordable and it makes my skin glow and personally it does tea help dark spots
Ever since i started uesinh this my acne scars have started to fade, also when ever I do get a pimple it doesnt scar as badly as normal and i tend to dcar easily and badly so that has bee amazing.

I'm on my third bottle and I love this product. I'm super acne prone, and even though this product doesn't fight acne I 100% see a difference with my post acne marks. I don't scar as bad, and I feel like i have less marks then before. This paired with an exfoliator is chefs kiss. I pick my acne, so I am guaranteed to scar. This helps so much. Unfortunately I will always have acne and pick, but luckily I will always have this product. I put a few friends on this and they have said they have better results with this than higher end products.

I have bought BOTTLES of this product and everytime I don't repurchase, I end up missing it! I am a skin picker and whenever I use this the night of picking at my face, the next morning the amount of inflammation is so much less than normal. I typically use this when picking my skin or when my barrier feels compromised. She isn't istantly cooling or soothing, but she will kill the inflammation by the next morning or night!!
Makes my skin feel nice and I have noticed a difference in how red my skin gets

This weekend my skin was both breaking out in some areas and red and inflammed in others. I browsed ulta looking for something to help and chose this because of the aloe vera in it. It helped speed up the time both issues needed to resolve and actually helped with irritation. I will definitely continue using this!

I love The Ordinary and their skincare items. It's my go to for all skincare items. I used this because I couldn't find the item I was using for dark spots & uneven skin tone. I have noticed a difference almost immediately within using this product. I am so happy with it & highly recommend it.
I was excited to try this seeing as I have a good amount of blemish scarring (thats red-ish and slightly dark). Within a few uses, I excitably saw results. After that…not so much.

I had been using the niacinamide and zinc for 5 years but lately it wasnt working as well. Started using this and I saw it clearing stubborn and new scars in less than a week! I wish i had taken before and after pictures! I also noticed it definitely helps with pore size and makes my skin look more glowing.

avis.titre: Love it! luxurious on skin but slightly tacky feel
avis.texte: I've been using this every morning after cleansing, hyaluronic acid, and niacinimide for acne control and texture. I love the glow it gives me after I'm done it's very glass skin like, but it does try a bit tacky. Sunscreen or moisturizer fixes that! I have super sensitive skin and I've had no problems with redness or breakouts.

I use this with the Matrixyl 10% + HA high strength wrinkle support serum in the mornings. I don't have wrinkles but the smoothness of my skin is awesome. This is a little tacky feeling, but after adding my tinted moisturizer, not so much.. This combo has made so much difference in my skin looking bright, glowing and smooth..

avis.titre: One of my favorite skin products so far
avis.texte: coming off trentenoin as it began to ruin my sensetive skin, this product has been a life saving for scarring, small blemishes and redness as well as overall hydration. Had never irritated sensitive skin or caused my breakouts. I use it very frequently, almost everyday morning and night and love the results.

After trying countless products to heal my damaged skin barrier I decided to try out this serum since I really liked the hyaluronic acid from this brand. In the last few months since I started using this the redness and acne scars on my face have almost completely faded! I'm someone who has very sensitive skin so I was very pleased to see such amazing results while not having any irritation from the serum. This stuff really helped repair my skin in the most gentle way.
I use it at night with my other ordinary products. I was worried a little bit because some people said they got irritated, but it's greatly improved my skin.

I tried this 2 different times to make sure it was this product before I wrote a review. This product broke me out in small pimples. I use a tried and true routine for many years and Im very careful when I add a new product. I like many other TO products but not this one.

Disclaimer - My skin is on the oily side, prone to the occasional hormonal breakout. Only knocked off one star because of the oily sheen this can give my skin, HOWEVER, a little goes a long way. Using less helps prevent more oil from forming. So perhaps it was user error on my end. Otherwise this is great. Had a couple noticeable acne scars on my face that were red in color. This helped make them go away and are sooooo much less noticeable now. When doing research in remedies for acne scarring, this product came up, and im so glad it did. Have bought it several times. I dont use daily, but i do use this roughly 4-5 times per week.

avis.titre: Can't really tell if it does anything
avis.texte: I use/have used a few different The Ordinary products throughout the last few years, this one being more recently. I think I have been using this for about 6 months now, maybe 8. I honestly can't really tell that it really helps with uneven skin, appearance of pores, etc. It's actually pretty good as a very light moisturizer and feels good as you're putting it on. It is a little sticky before it dries, but I layer products so I don't care about the finish of it. I guess I'll stop using it for a while to see if my skin reacts lol

avis.titre: It works really well for reducing redness and acne marks
avis.texte: I have tried other things that claim to help with post acne marks and none of them worked that well. I was so surprised by how well this works. It speeds up healing tremendously! It also helps a lot with redness. Very impressed.

The texture is like a serum. It takes a while for it to be absorbed into the skin. There is really no scent that I can tell from this product. The packaging from The Ordinary is always great and you always get a good price for product.

So I actually used this because an ulta employee recommended it to me for my acne skin and scars. While I saw not much improvement from scars, I did see improvement in my acne and texture. Made me look a lot flawless than usual due to it fixing my textures. Will buy again!

I got this a bit ago and I used it for 8 weeks just to see what it would do, I struggled with scarring, redness, texture, and a broken skin barrier. This serum didn't really help with the the darker scarring, but it definitely did help with the lighter and smaller spots here and there. Completely fixed my skin barrier, and therefore also fixed my redness (one issue came from the other) I'M TELLING YOU I GOT SO MANY COMPLIMENTS. My skin texture also definitely improved a lot, my skin feels a whole lot smoother. Not only did this serum work wonders but it's also super moisturizing and leaves the skin with a satin finish. Love it.

Very healing, it's my first time getting into skin care products at 22 since i've been breaking out very badly after getting sick and I have to say i'm impressed. I've never been interested in the skin care world since it's so overwhelming with all the options out there but i'm glad i did some looking around ! It's been about a month since my purchase & i can see a lot of improvement. No cons for me so far.

I have sensitive skin so unfortunately this serum didn't work out for me It was leaving my face red and burning I really wish it had worked out because other skin care products from this line worked great on my skin

I didn't find that this was super effective or helpful. I typically don't breakout often, but when I do, I was hoping this would help with the redness and aftermath, but it didn't. The packaging is nice and easy to use and I didn't notice much of a scent. It also feels nice on the skin especially since I have dry skin. Overall, I would not repurchase

Super light solution that doesn't feel too Oily or overbearing. Small amount of applied solution dries quickly and leaves a glow. No overbearing scent or texture. A lot of solution for the small bottle. Would purchase again

I bought this a week or two ago and so far it is just okay. I was using the niacinamide and zinc serum and my skin was looking better. After adding this to my routine I've noticed more breakouts on my forehead, an area which I don't usually breakout or get many pimples on.

I have sensitive skin but also very clear skin, mainly hormonal acne or just from workong and working out (sweat) but this stuff has helped immensely w using a moistuizer eye cream and this only, reduced my redness and spots
This product was very effective. The texture was great. I wasn't a fan of the scent and you got a lot for the value. The packaging was clean and crisp.

An effective product that quickly works. Used this while on a trip to Mexico and noticed I had no redness on my face the entire time. The aloe definitely works and is moisturizing and soothing. Would absolutely recommend for anyone with sensitive skin or even someone who just got some sun in the warmer months.

I have been using this for a month and I'm never going back! Been using for a month and my skin texture is smooth, even, plump, and bright. This product has helped me so much and other people notice the difference. I've always struggled with acne and scaring but this product seems to be preventing my acne too.

I brought this 4 months ago, almost finished the bottle and it's done absolutely nothing to my skin, not reduced redness or uneven skin tone, my skin looks exactly the same as 4 months ago so I will not be repurchasing.

i've been using this morning and evening for over a week now , it sometimes irritates my skin, making it itchy, but the product itself is very lightweight and quite effective. it's helped my skin texture, making it feel and the appearance of it more smooth than before.

I used this for a few days and now my face especially my forehead is covered in little white pimples allllll over and it's itchy my face looks crazy and this is the only thing I've change. I'm so sad I don't know what to do to fix it

I bought this a couple weeks ago and I've been using it in the evening before my moisturizer. Skin feels lovely right after and especially in the morning. Too soon to notice any real change. But I did put it directly on a pimple that was starting and it was pretty much gone the next day. I have a question though for anyone that may know.. can I use it with the Niacinamide 10%+zinc 1% solution? I bought that too at the same time but unsure if I can use together and how/when. Thank you 😊

I suffered with acne on my chin for a while, finally found the cause of it and my chin cleared up but had the dreaded red scars left. I bought this because it was recommended to me in-store for my red acne marks on my chin. I've been using it for a week now and noticed I started breaking out again on my chin area! I was finally in a more happy place with more confidence with no acne and this product has brought me back to the start...

I bought this about a week ago and I am someone with acne/ sensitive skin. At first, it seemed to soothe the redness in my skin a bit, but after about 3-4 days, my skin started breaking out in large and small pimples all over my face. Absolutely terrible product.
So so so good if you are struggling with acne marks. Saw a decrease in marks and has left my skin looking like glass! Highly recommend if you are prone to having acne blemishes!
This is like magic for your face. Any blemishes you have will disappear overnight or within a day of using. Great for spot treatment or larger areas.
Used it for 1.5 months, didnt cause irritation but no result tho

I received this in an ordinary box. I use this every time I wax my face or use an exfoliating treatment, and it is very soothing to the skin. It's very lightweight and soaks in very quickly. It doesn't pill which is very nice.
my skin has never felt better, it calms irritation so well, especially around my acne scars, thank you, theOrdinary! my reddness has dissapeared! (age 17)
This has helped my skin so much! The aloe in this product really helps. Keeps my skin feeling moisturized all day! 10/10 would recommend this product..
Used it now for about two weeks and Its brought me out in little spots, sadly a fail from the ordinary as this has never happened to me before with any of the other products
My skin definitely feels clearer and more even toned. I don't suffer with a lot of acne but when I do this really helps clear my face up and tone down inflammation.

This serum is so good. I have been using it for the past month and a half, and I have noticed a huge difference in my skin's overall texture. My pores are less noticeable in my T-zone, and my skin is a lot smoother. I have very oily, acne-prone skin, and I also saw an improvement in blemishes! I usually get large cystic bumps on my chin and neck, and it seemed to allow the ones I had to go down and heal and keep new ones at bay. The aloe was also very soothing! Because of my cystic acne, my skin is usually red and inflamed, so this helped a lot. If you also suffer from cystic acne, give this a try!! p.s. I will say I went through this product fairly quickly. It says to apply a few drops morning and evening, so I went with 2-3 twice daily. I'm not sure if my drops were just large ones, but I ran out of this product about two months in. So keep that in mind! But I don't mind rebuying it so soon because it really has changed my skin!

I just recently found out that i have post inflammatory erythema and i have tried so many products from bha to tretinoin to clindamycin, etc and i still couldn't get rid of the redness. My face is very sensitive and when i get pimples the area gets very inflamed. I tried this product 2 weeks ago and this is my face now. SO MUCH MORE CALM. It lasts so long because you only need a few drops every morning and every night and my skin has no irritation or servere reaction to this. I WILL KEEP USING FOREVER.

The ordinary 2% + Nag 2 % solution worked amazingly well for my sensitive skin. As an adult I have been struggling with acne, and I have tried multiple different products that were not helping at all. Once I tried the ordinary serum, I immediately saw results in the first week, my acne was clearing up, I have been using this bottle ever since. If you struggle with acne or have acne scars I recommend using this serum :)

This product is my new holy grail. I was skeptical of this product at first when I found out the cost but decided to try it out. When I tell you I have used every last drop I'm not kidding. This product leaves your skin feeling so soft and glowing. This serum will make any breakouts disappear within a few days. Go get yourself a bottle asap!

avis.titre: I don't know how to layer it
avis.texte: Hi. I just purchased this product. But I struggle with layering it. So I think I will be able to use it only in the mornings because in the evenings, I use tretinoin and exfoliating acids, and these products can not be used with them. Usually in the mornings I use ascorbic acid which is not a good match with this product either. So can layer it with niacinamide and ascorbyl + vitamin F (if Yes, which comes first?) Thank you in advance.

Just finished my bottle. No reduction in sensitivity or redness. Pores and scars are as awful as they were when I began using this bottle. Much more obvious sebaceous filaments and increase in pustules. Oh the bright side, I think my skin became slightly more moisturized with this. Sticky texture as it begins to dry (takes a long time to soak in), but feels nice going on.

I have been using this product for a few months now and I've noticed no change in my post acne marks, unfortunately. Maybe it will work for less red or very mild post acne marks but mine are really quite defined. So this is the first Ordinary product that hasn't worked very well for me unfortunately.

The overall redness in my skin has declined substantially when using this and even though it is a bit sticky it absorbs quickly and nicely with a little bit of added moisturization to the skin. I used it most often to thin out a thick moisturizer I love and it works perfectly. This may appear to be like other serums but this is a thinner more watery texture and if you experience "product overload" this would be ideal for you.
Hi! my name is Izzy and when I bought this serum, I honestly just bought it for fun and because everyone else had it. But I came to realize I had an amazing choice! I really suggest this serum!!!
This product is easy to use and not too goopy, although, I'm not sure I felt like it did all that much for me. I will keep trying it out and see if I can tell any changes.

avis.titre: May be best suited to very mild inflammation
avis.texte: I've been using this for about two months. I don't notice much of a difference in my acne marks, but I do find it makes a noticeable difference in the redness I usually have around my nose, which is a welcome surprise.

The ordinary aloe 2% + NAG 2% solution worked so amazingly well for me. As an adult, I started struggling with acne, and I have tried so many different products that were not helping. Once I tried the ordinary serum, I immediately saw results and my acne disappearing quicker. I have since purchased another bottle and have been using regularly. If you are struggling with acne like I was, I would recommend this product to you !￼
i was nervouse at first but then saw after one week how it brightened my face and also made my acne scars go away. My acne scars always be bothering me but this serum did some work.
This serum calmed the redness I experienced on my cheeks from acne and helped smooth out my texture. I had fewer breakouts after a week and it's easy to apply
This product has helped clear my face so much. It is now part of my daily skin care routine. I have sensitive combination skin and this product is lightweight but still gets the job done.

avis.titre: Didn't sooth or reduce the redness
avis.texte: Until now I have tried 4 products from the ordinary and non of them was good > Hylorinc acid serum was sticky for my oily skin and it peels out after I apply on it moisturizer or sunscreen > niacinamide serum I used it for the pores but I stopped it after 2 days because it burned my skin and made it red with blemishes > aloe serum I bought it to help with the redness caused by niacinamide serum but it didn't help > eyelash and eyebrow serum was drying the skin around my eyebrows I will not buy again any of the ordinary products because I had bad experience with the one I purchased and tried.
I feel nothing about this serum. It doesn't make my skin feel moisture. Solution has an extremely lightweight, almost water-like texture. When I use sunscreen after, sometimes it makes cast.

I have really oily, acne prone skin and this stuff made my face look so much better. It's been awhile since I've actually had a skin care product fully deliver. This helped calm my breakouts and even my face out. I really love this product and will repurchase.

I have started Adapalene, and while I am still on twice per week, I noticed mild irritation next day. I got the aloe+nag as soothing serum and from day one irritation next morning is gone. To my delight, even other people noticed the difference. :) I am looking forward to combining it with barrier support. Right now I am combining with Niacinamide serum 10% (Although i am not fond of such a high concentration). Apparently, it has been reported there a good synergy with Niancninimide
This product caused my sensitive, dry skin to become more irritated, dry out more, and caused any products I put on top of it to pill.

avis.titre: Need a filter to remove "Free Product" reviews.
avis.texte: "Received Free Product" reviews are worthless overall. I am dubious that they are helpful or trustworthy. Please include an option to eliminate them in your sorting filter. Haven't tried product b/c not able to find many unsolicited, unbiased reviews. Ergo, 1 star.

I liked this! It was hydrating and didn't irritate my skin which is nice. It went on under moisturizer well and did not pill, I think it also sunk into the skin quickly and didn't feel greasy or oily on top of my skin.
Love this for my combination acne prone skin. Did not break me out and I definitely saw a difference in my hyperpigmentation. I would definitely recommend as it did not irritate my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Sensitive skin users don't take this risk
avis.texte: Do NOT recommend this product. I have been using the ordinary for years, it's great that they are coming out with new stuff but not when it doesn't work for you. Most of the reviews here were from influencers that were given this product for free sadly. I had high hopes being a avid TO user. However, this product broke my skin out. I now have chemical burns! Also caused redness. Now I have to re-fix the damage. Not for everyday use!!!!
I am an avid user of Ordinary. They have the best and inexpensive products. This solution made my acne prone and oily skin feel and look super smooth.
Love this. I put it on before putting on my moisturizer and it makes my face feel so great. I would recommend this for anyone who is looking for a product like this to add to this skin care routine

As someone with acne prone sensitive skin, I've always had a slight fear when it comes to trying out new skincare. Seeing as this not only had aloe (which I know is super hydrating and healing) but also a pigment lightener, I was super excited to try this. My acne is always a huge insecurity of mine but more than that, the scars it leaves behind is the worst part. Within a week of using this I already saw a great improvement in all aspects of my skin including my hyperpigmentation. Safe to say this is my new go to.
This broke me out really badly. I just don't think it's for my kind of skin at all I have combination skin so maybe that's the problem I do like their other products though

avis.titre: Can use on my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've tried various post-acne lighteners which were irritating and inflamming on my sensitive skin. I have been able to use this, including on red marks after breakouts on my thin, sensitive decolletage area skin. Too soon to tell how long or how much everything will lighten but its not causing irritation which is a first for me.

avis.titre: It seemed to work almost instantly!
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple of weeks now and I don't know if I'm imagining things but some scars I've had on the side of my face for years are suddenly reduced! It has also seemed to calm any new spots almost immediately. I can't believe it. I use it alongside niacinamide, which I've used for a few years now, and argan oil in the evening.

I can't say I love nor dislike this product. I've recently added it to my night routine and it certainly helps boost the moisturizing of my skin, but I can't say that I have seen a major difference. Maybe my skin feels a little softer and looks calmer.. I'll continue to use this product and maybe I'll see a bigger difference, but at least it is moisturizing.

I brought this about 4 weeks ago to clear some dark marks on my cheeks , jaw line and neck after buying another product that promised it would do the same thing only.to make it worse ( sorry clinique! ) and I'm really impressed. Whilst it hasn't completely cleared the dark spots they are significantly reduced. Will be ordering it again.

I am 21 years old and have struggled with acne since 12 years old. You can only imagine everything I have tried. Now, I dont suffer as much from breakouts, but more from the left over marks and redness. THIS serum does exactly what its supposed to do, and FAST. I have oily skin, sensitive skin, and fhis is it right here. I use this at night and in the morning I use Alpha Arbutin and Azeliac acid cream. Buy this. Trust me.

Really liked this better than other serums from the Ordinary! I don't know if it actually improved my skin texture or color, but I felt like it went on so smooth and easily layered with other products, and wasn't too oily.

Bought this after seeing it on tiktok for scaring and ive noticed a HUGE difference in the redness in the bad scars and the smaller ones are completely gone. It also has worked great on actual acne ive noticed my cystic acne goes away quicker with this
I really like this product. It was extremely hydrating and not drying. I will be purchasing it again I felt like it helped with slightly clearing up my skin.
I have pretty sensitive skin and this seemed to be ok for me but not as good compared to my normal high need skincare but I feel like this would be good for the price point
I like this product because it is affordable and it feels lightweight on the face. I used it to target post acne scaring and felt like I noticed a difference in my skin.

avis.titre: Perfect daily day time acne serum
avis.texte: Dries quickly, can be used daily on acne prone skin. I'm using it during summer months and don't find it makes my skin greasy even though says for dry skin and I have combination. I just wish it came in the larger format like some of the other serums!
I havent noticed a big difference in my skin with this. But its very sticky & i dont like that.
This is a nice thing s serum. I like way it applies on the face. The price point is very good for the product. I wasn't sure exactly what this product was supposed to help with though.
Does exactly what it says and works amazing! Love it so much!!

I was really skeptical about this product when i purchased it, but was totally shocked by the results! This serum makes the leftover redness from acne disappear so quickly! My skin has been more even and glowy.
It made my face oily, and smooth! It didn't smell very good, and was more like honey constancy. I probably wouldn't recommend this product to anyone!

Bought this at the end of April after having post-acne marks and acne for years. In my mind it has significantly improved in terms of redness and overall texture. I have been using this product AM and PM since April without the need for a moisturizer as my skin is an oily type. I would definitely purchase again with the intention of revamping my skincare routine to include more steps and a deeper fix for the acne marks that have left holes in my face. Overall, definitely a must for red acne marks.
This has quickly become one of my favorite brands. The price is right and the ingredients are amazingly good!! Highly recommend 10 out of 10 need!
I gave this to my teenage brother who breaks out and so far he's loving it and it's been helping him with his acne. He says it's moisturizing and he uses almost everyday.

avis.titre: Noticed a difference the first day
avis.texte: This serum reduces the redness in my skin and makes it feel softer. It also blurs the look of my pores without drying out my skin. I noticed reduced redness and smoother texture from the first day of use.

This serum helps improve the appearance of large pores and uneven skin tone. It helps brighten the skin by also moisturizing it. This serum also helps improve post acne blemishes. I would definitely recommend to add this serum to your skin care routine!
This is an ok product. It does feel nice on the skin and I have seen many influences rave about it however I don't think I've used it enough to see a real difference.

Wow this is a pretty great product for the price, a serum that is extremely moisturizing and has serum benefits that allows me to not have to put a moisturizer on in addition! I have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this product
I like serum it's hydrating but what I feel it work's slowly overall I like packaging smell consistency results are bit slow u can give it a try I have very dry flaky skin
DO NOT BUY THIS!!! this product gave me chemical burns on my face. it was incredibly painful and itchy. i only used the serum for 3 days. save ur face from the burns and don't buy.
I like to use this when my face is feeling dry and its really nice especially in the summer months when i get a lot of sun on my face. Good product and would definitely repurchase.

I start my first routine with TO by using HA because is the most popular product and advertised a lot. Unfortunately wasn't matched with my skin. This happened in 2020. I had very sensitive skin with blemish probes and black heads, lack of hydration. After 1 bottle which I tried to used in many ways my conclusion was and is still actual: Hyaluronic acid is note suitable for my skin. I love Buffer plus copper but because of HA is make me a lot of headache. So, I replace with Amino Acid+B5 and my skin was changed straight and almost of blemish gone. I tried Niacinamide to help with my pores but was tooooo much, was fell like a mask. Long time I was waiting for the same target but for dry skin ❤️. I used first bottle in less than 5 weeks. Since was able to buy in O.Lab. This product plumb my skin and I had really spot-off skin when I used it. Have a really light fragrance which is come off very quickly but I like it and I observed less dark spot on my nose. With a texture like HA but is not the same. Under face cream and makeup is perfect. Just an amazing product.
Didn't find that it really make a difference in my skin care routine. Could definitely live without it. Nothing special about it. Wont be repurchasing.

I have tried the ordinay's niacinimide serum before for my pores and it caused some irritation and discomfort. Still in need of a solution for some large pores I thought I'd try this and it works really well! After a couple of weeks I've noticed a reduction in size of my problem areas. I use this only in those areas as its kind of sticky. Dabbing or pressing it into the skin helps some and after it dries/absorbs it's not noticeable. I will be repurchasing this serum.

So here's the deal… I've battled with my skin barrier for a long time, years and years. Most often I had oily skin with a gritty feeling and surface flakiness and minor redness (not rosacea but eczema). Most serums never worked on their own for me, always needed to layer heavier cream on top but that always made me feel too greasy and didn't properly penetrate my skin. When wearing makeup it always looked ok first but then started to flake and look bad later, especially on my forehead which has always been drier than the rest of my face. I've used this for about a month now and I'm blown away on how comfortable, smooth and balanced my skin feels, without needing other creams on top. All flakiness is gone, my skin tone is even and I don't feel at all self conscious when wearing makeup or the need to check if I look flakey or not. Honestly this has to be a staple for everyone. Not just "dry skin" as it's SO SO lightweight and water based. The best thing you can do for your skin is to maintain a healthy barrier, and this serum does exactly that. PS. I don't have bad acne marks but the tiny one or two I used to have are also faded without me realizing.

I was fortunate to have received this product to test out! I am a huge fan of the Ordinary's products. I have oily skin with the occasional break out and have tried their niacinamide, HA, and buffet serums. This is the only one that I can physically see immediate results. It leaves my skin very soft and plump and does not feel heavy on my skin. It wears beautifully under makeup and keeps the breakouts at bay.

avis.titre: Didn't have any noticable effect on my skin
avis.texte: Now that I finished a full bottle of this, I feel like I can confidently say that it didn't have any real noticeable effect on my skin. The positives are that it didn't break me out at all, it has a nice texture and wears well under makeup, and it feels nice and soothing upon application. It felt hydrating and gentle on the skin. However, long term I saw no real benefits. The redness in my skin was no better than it always has been. My acne scars didn't fade or have any improvement with use of this product. And it didn't feel any more moisturizing than if I'd just used any other serum. Since it didn't cause me any irritation or breakouts and it did feel overall nice, I certainly don't think it hurts to try! But personally I'm trying to simplify my skincare routine and anything that isn't giving me noticeable benefits gets cut, and that was the case for this serum. I don't think it's a bad product by any stretch, and perhaps if my skin was more irritated and sensitized this would have made a difference, but for where my skin is it it just wasn't doing much. I would recommend giving it a try because it can't hurt and maybe you'll see some benefit, but maybe don't go in expecting it to be a heavy hitter in your regimen
